content.value_statement: Billing systems need accurate renewals, invoices, taxes, retries, and subscription state handling. This skill provides implementation patterns for reliable recurring billing workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains subscription lifecycle states, trials, pauses, cancellations, and renewals.
Shows billing cycle processing with invoice generation and payment retry handling.
Provides dunning workflow patterns for failed payment recovery and customer notices.
Describes proration calculations for plan changes and seat changes.
Covers invoice structure, tax calculation, and usage-based billing examples.
limitations: Provides reference patterns, not a complete production billing service.
Uses illustrative Python snippets that require real storage, APIs, and tests.
Does not provide current tax rates or legal compliance advice.
Requires integration with a payment processor and email delivery service.

use_cases.title: Launch SaaS Subscriptions
use_cases.description: Design trials, renewals, invoices, and payment attempts for a new subscription product.

use_cases.title: Improve Failed Payment Recovery
use_cases.description: Create retry schedules, customer notices, grace periods, and cancellation rules for overdue accounts.

use_cases.title: Model Complex Billing Rules
use_cases.description: Plan proration, seat changes, tax handling, and usage charges before implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Map a Billing Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new recurring billing feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this billing automation skill to outline a monthly subscription flow with trial, renewal, invoice, payment, and failed payment states.

prompt_templates.title: Design Dunning Rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup for failed payment recovery.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a dunning schedule for our SaaS product. Include retry timing, emails, grace periods, and cancellation rules.

prompt_templates.title: Specify Proration Logic
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced billing changes across plans and seats.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to define proration behavior for upgrades, downgrades, seat additions, seat removals, and annual to monthly changes.

prompt_templates.title: Review Billing Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review our billing architecture for subscriptions, invoices, payment retries, tax handling, usage charges, and audit events.

output_examples.input: Plan billing for a monthly SaaS subscription with a 14 day trial.
output_examples.output: A lifecycle plan covering trial start, activation, invoice creation, payment attempt, renewal, past due handling, and cancellation behavior.

output_examples.input: Create a failed payment recovery process for overdue invoices.
output_examples.output: A dunning sequence with retry dates, customer email stages, grace periods, payment recovery handling, and final cancellation criteria.

output_examples.input: Define billing rules for plan upgrades and usage-based charges.
output_examples.output: A billing design covering proration, seat changes, usage aggregation, tiered pricing, invoice line items, and tax calculation checkpoints.

best_practices: Keep billing state transitions explicit and auditable.
Test proration, retry, tax, and cancellation paths with realistic edge cases.
Separate payment processing, invoice generation, customer notices, and accounting records.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode billing dates, tax rates, or retry rules in production without configuration.
Do not cancel accounts before clear notices, retry attempts, and grace periods.
Do not treat sample code as production-ready without security, compliance, and payment tests.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps design recurring billing, subscription lifecycle logic, invoice generation, dunning, proration, tax handling, and usage-based billing.

faq.question: Does it include a complete billing application?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation patterns and examples that need real storage, APIs, validation, and tests.

faq.question: Can I use it with Stripe or another payment processor?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples use payment processor concepts, but you must adapt them to your provider and compliance requirements.

faq.question: Does it provide tax or legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It explains tax calculation patterns, but you should verify rates, rules, and obligations with qualified experts.

faq.question: Is this skill useful for usage-based pricing?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes patterns for tracking usage, aggregating records, and calculating tiered, per-unit, and volume charges.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
